statements.status_notes: bootstrap 3.4.1 is bundled as a static JS asset inside nbclassic 1.3.3, the latest release of the classic Jupyter Notebook UI extension shipped by zero-to-jupyterhub-k8s 4.4.1. CVE-2025-1647 describes a DOM-based XSS vulnerability in Bootstrap 3.4.1. Bootstrap 3.x has reached end-of-life and no upstream fix is available for the 3.x branch. The Bootstrap library cannot be upgraded independently of nbclassic; remediation would require an upstream nbclassic release adopting Bootstrap 4.x or later, a major breaking change. Bootstrap's vulnerable UI components (tooltips, popovers) are only reachable by authenticated users interacting with the classic notebook UI. Investigation is ongoing to assess mitigating controls and to monitor for upstream action.

Same purl and rationale as CVE-2024-6485: bootstrap 3.4.1 is bundled into nbclassic static assets and only loaded if a user actively chooses the legacy /tree UI. The default JupyterLab 4.x UI does not load it.

bootstrap 3.4.1 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI; the default UI shipped here is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own styling and does not load nbclassic's bootstrap bundle. The XSS path runs in the user's browser only if they navigate to the classic UI under /tree, and only with input the user controls (notebook content rendered into their own browser).
